messages.content: Use the delegate_task tool to have a sub-agent read bay4.txt and report the winch code written in it. Then tell me the code, and only the code.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from the workspace. Give a path relative to the workspace root. Returns the file with line numbers, so you can refer to a line by number afterwards.

from_line.description: First line to return, counting from 1. Omit to start at the top.

lines.description: How many lines to return. Omit to read to the end.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root, such as src/main.rs

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List what is in a directory of the workspace. Give a path relative to the workspace root, or "." for the root itself. Entries are numbered and directories are marked with a trailing slash. A directory too large to show at once comes back in parts, and the last line says how to ask for the next part.

from.description: Number of the first entry to return, as numbered in a previous listing of the same directory. Omit to start at the beginning.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root. Use "." for the root.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find every line in the workspace that contains a phrase. Give plain text, not a pattern: it is matched literally and case-insensitively. Answers with paths and line numbers, which read_file takes as from_line. Use this before reading files when you do not know which file holds something.

from.description: Number of the first match to return, as numbered in a previous search for the same text. Omit to start at the beginning.

path.description: Directory to search, relative to the workspace root. Omit to search all of it.

text.description: The text to find. Matched literally, ignoring case.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a text file in the workspace, replacing whatever was there. Give a path relative to the workspace root and the whole new contents. Read the file first if you are changing part of it: this replaces all of it.

content.description: The whole new contents of the file.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root, such as src/main.rs

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete one file from the workspace. Give a path relative to the workspace root. It removes a single file, never a directory, and what it removes cannot be put back.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root, such as notes/old.txt

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command and read what it printed. It starts in the workspace root unless you give a directory. Use this for building, testing, searching and version control. A command that exits with a non-zero status counts as failed. Very long output is cut, and the result says how much was left out.

command.description: The command line to run, as you would type it in a terminal.

cwd.description: Directory to start in, relative to the workspace root. Omit to start in the root.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this long. Omit for 60 seconds. At most 600.

tools.name: delegate_task
tools.description: Hand a self-contained piece of work to a sub-agent with a fresh context window and the tools you have. Use it when the work would otherwise fill this conversation up: searching, reading many files, a repetitive pass, an investigation whose steps you do not need to keep. Write the task as everything the sub-agent needs, because it starts with none of this conversation. You get back only its final answer; nothing it did on the way reaches you.

task.description: What the sub-agent should do and what it should report back, written so that somebody who has not read this conversation could do it.
